1.en: perceptual RGB (input assumed in [0,1]) -> H in [0,360), S/L in [0,1]

2.zh: 六个色相区间的三角权重，归一化后之和为 1。half_width 以度为单位，取 60 以上即可完整覆盖整个色环
2.en: Triangular weights for the six hue ranges, normalised to sum to 1. half_width is in degrees; 60 or more guarantees full coverage of the hue circle.

3.zh: 退化兜底：归到最近的区间
3.en: degenerate fallback: snap to the nearest range

5.zh: 感知（非线性）RGB：色相/饱和度的运算不能放在线性光下做，否则中间调会相对 GIMP 滤镜反向偏移
5.en: Perceptual (non-linear) RGB: hue/saturation maths must not run in linear light, otherwise mid-tones shift the wrong way compared with GIMP's filter.

6.zh: half_width 取 60° 时六个区间刚好无缝铺满色环；overlap 让它们变宽，相邻区间互相渗透
6.en: half_width 60deg makes the six ranges tile the hue circle exactly; overlap widens them so neighbours blend into each other.

7.zh: 无需处理：直接拷贝，alpha 保持不变
7.en: nothing to do: a plain copy keeps alpha untouched

8.zh: 无彩像素：色相没有意义，保持原来的灰
8.en: achromatic pixel: hue is meaningless, keep it grey
